items.label: section_header
items.text: REACTIONSINVOLVINGIRONCOMPLEXES

items.label: section_header
items.text: REACTIONOFIRON(II)COMPLEXESWITHALKALIS

items.label: text
items.text: Consider the reaction that occurs when aqueous sodium hydroxide is added to a solution containing the hexaaquairon(Il) ion until nofurther change is seen.The observation is that a pale green solution forms a green precipitate. The equation for this reaction is:

items.label: formula
items.text: [Fe(H₂O)₆]²⁺ + 2OH⁻ → [Fe(H₂O)₄(OH)₂] + 2H₂O

items.label: text
items.text: As with copper and cobalt, this is a deprotonation reaction-the two hydroxideions have removed hydrogenionsfromtwoofthewaterligandsandconvertedthemintowatermolecules.Thetwo water ligands that have lost hydrogen ions are now hydroxide ligands.

items.label: text
items.text: Thesameobservationscanbemadewhen aqueous ammonia isusedasthealkali.Theequationfor the deprotonationreactionis:

items.label: formula
items.text: [Fe(H₂O)₆]²⁺ + 2NH₃ → [Fe(H₂O)₄(OH)₂] + 2NH₄⁺

items.label: text
items.text: Upon standing,the colour of the green precipitate gradually changes to brown as oxygen from the atmosphere causes oxidation,forming [Fe(H2O)s(OH)3] - this is the triaquatrihydroxoiron(III) complex.

items.label: section_header
items.text: REACTIONOFIRON(III)COMPLEXESWITHALKALIS

items.label: text
items.text: Consider the reaction that occurs when aqueous sodium hydroxide is added to a solution containing the hexaaquairon(Ill) ion until no further change is seen. The observation is that a yellow-brown solutionformsabrownprecipitate.Theequationforthisreactionis:

items.label: formula
items.text: [Fe(H₂O)₆]³⁺ + 3OH⁻ → [Fe(H₂O)₃(OH)₃] + 3H₂O

items.label: text
items.text: As with iron(Il), this is a deprotonation reaction -the three hydroxide ions have removed hydrogen ionsfromthreeofthewaterligands andconverted themintowatermolecules.Thethreewater ligands that havelost hydrogenions are nowhydroxideligands.

items.label: text
items.text: The same observations can bemade when aqueous ammonia is used as the alkali.The equation for thedeprotonationreactionis:

items.label: formula
items.text: [Fe(H₂O)₆]³⁺ + 3NH₃ → [Fe(H₂O)₃(OH)₃] + 3NH₄⁺

items.label: text
items.text: There are nofurtherreactions when an excess of either aqueous sodium hydroxide or aqueous ammonia is added and no further changes upon standing.
